summary.title: Buod (Filipino)
summary.body: Ang mga review sa i-PESO ay galing lamang sa mga taong totoong nag-apply o nagtrabaho sa kumpanya. Hindi ipinapakita ang iyong pangalan. Isulat ang tapat mong karanasan. Bawal ang pagmumura, panlalait, diskriminasyon, at paglalagay ng pangalan, numero ng telepono o email ng ibang tao. Kung may seryosong problema tulad ng paniningil ng bayad o pekeng trabaho, i-report ito sa PESO. Ang mga tapat na review, kahit hindi maganda, ay hindi tinatanggal.

sections.title: Why reviews exist
sections.body: Reviews help job seekers in Urdaneta City decide where to apply, and help employers see how their hiring and workplace are experienced. They only work if they are honest, fair to both sides, and based on real experience.

sections.title: Who can review
sections.body:
Every review is tied to something that really happened in i-PESO:

- **Recruitment Experience:** you applied to the employer, and they responded to your application (or you withdrew). If an employer doesn't respond for 14 days, you can rate their communication and the job posting.
- **Employment Experience:** you were hired through i-PESO (or the employer reported your hire to PESO), and your start date has arrived.

You can write one review of each kind per application or job. You can edit it or take it back at any time.

sections.title: What to write about
sections.body:
**For a Recruitment review, rate how the hiring was handled, not whether you got the job.** Was the employer clear and quick to reply? Was the process organized and fair? Were you treated with respect? Did the job posting describe the job honestly?

**For an Employment review,** describe the workplace you experienced: the work environment, how management treats staff, and whether the pay, duties and schedule matched the posting.

Be specific and stick to your own experience. Negative reviews are welcome when they are honest and respectful.

sections.title: What is not allowed
sections.body:
- Profanity, insults, threats or harassment of anyone.
- Discrimination or remarks about age, sex, gender, religion, disability, ethnicity, civil status, pregnancy or similar traits.
- Personal information: names of individual staff or applicants, phone numbers, emails, addresses or social media accounts.
- Accusations of crimes you can't back up. Report those to PESO instead (see below).
- Fake reviews, reviews written for someone else, or reviews written in exchange for money, favors or pressure.
- Advertising, links and content unrelated to the employer.

sections.title: Serious problems
sections.body: If an employer asked you for a placement or processing fee, posted a fake job, or treated you abusively, use**Report this employer** on the company profile. A report goes straight to PESO for investigation. A review alone is not enough for problems like these, so please report them too.

sections.title: Your name and privacy
sections.body:
- Your name is never shown. Others see you as a Verified applicant or Verified employee, with the month of your review.
- The employer never sees who wrote a review. PESO staff can see it, only to verify and moderate.
- Employers can give feedback about people they hired. The comments are private: only you and PESO can read them, on your My Reviews page, once you have reviewed that workplace or 14 days after they wrote it, whichever comes first. Employers you apply to can see your average rating from employers, how many employers rated you and how many would hire you again, but never the comments or which companies wrote them.

How i-PESO handles personal data is explained in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: For employers
sections.body:
- You can post **one public reply** to each review. Keep it professional and don't try to identify the reviewer.
- You cannot edit, hide or delete reviews. If a review breaks these guidelines, **dispute it** and PESO will check it.
- Never pressure, reward or retaliate against anyone for a review, or for not writing one.
- Feedback about people you hired must be about their work: professionalism, communication, reliability and job performance.

sections.title: How PESO moderates
sections.body:
- Comments with contact details, links or profanity are held for PESO to read before they appear.
- Anyone can report a review. A review reported by three different people is held until PESO decides.
- PESO keeps reviews that follow these guidelines, including negative ones, and hides reviews that don't. When a review is hidden, the writer is told why and can edit it.
- Every moderation decision is recorded in i-PESO's activity log.

Questions about these guidelines can be brought to the PESO office in Urdaneta City.
